t: Hewlett-Packard Company | History & Facts | Britannica Money
s: In August 2011 Hewlett-Packard announced that it would discontinue making smartphones and its tablet computer, the TouchPad (which had debuted only seven weeks earlier in July), and that it was considering spinning off its PC business into a separate company. Henceforth, Hewlett-Packard would concentrate on software and services for business, and it acquired the British business software company Autonomy Corporation for $11.1 billion.

Its operations are organized into seven segments: the Personal Systems Group (PSG), Services, the Imaging and Printing Group (IPG), Enterprise Servers, Storage and Networking (ESSN), HP Software, HP Financial Services (HPFS) and Corporate Investments. In March 2012, HP had consolidated PSG and IPG into a Printing and Personal Systems Group.
